push_nudge_attempt_state_check.name: push_nudge_attempt_state_check
push_nudge_attempt_state_check.value: ("push_subscriptions"."nudge_attempt_date" IS NULL AND "push_subscriptions"."nudge_attempt_count" = 0) OR ("push_subscriptions"."nudge_attempt_date" IS NOT NULL AND "push_subscriptions"."nudge_attempt_count" BETWEEN 1 AND 3)

push_nudge_retry_state_check.name: push_nudge_retry_state_check
push_nudge_retry_state_check.value: "push_subscriptions"."nudge_retry_after" IS NULL OR ("push_subscriptions"."nudge_attempt_date" IS NOT NULL AND "push_subscriptions"."nudge_lease_token" IS NULL)
